title: A Systematic Study and Comprehensive Evaluation of ChatGPT on Benchmark Datasets
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured two main aspects related to faith/religion: 1) The model's response patterns to manually constructed ethical dilemma questions that integrate religious biases. 2) The model's knowledge of 'world religions' as part of the Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) benchmark.
findings: The paper found that when presented with ethical dilemma questions involving religious biases, ChatGPT tends to remain neutral and provide expert-like opinions that argue for all possible scenarios. In the MMLU benchmark, ChatGPT achieved an 80.12% accuracy on the 'world religions' subtask.
